about_the_game:
Travel back over 2,000 years and walk in the footsteps of Jesus Christ — from His baptism to the resurrection. Inspired by the New Testament, I Am Jesus Christ offers a unique spiritual simulation experience.

Are you ready to resist temptation in the desert, heal the sick, and uplift those in need? Perform over 30 meaningful miracles — from feeding the 5,000 and healing lepers to calming the storm and restoring sight to the blind.

Deepen your connection with the Holy Spirit through prayer, as new gameplay mechanics blend with timeless biblical stories. I Am Jesus Christ seeks to share the Gospel in an engaging and respectful way.

Experience over 10 hours of immersive gameplay through deserts, waters, and mountains — leading to the profound story of Christ’s crucifixion and resurrection.

Key features:

- Relive the life of Jesus Christ from His birth to the crucifixion and resurrection

- Visit faithfully recreated locations in the Holy Land, including Jerusalem and the Galilee

- Perform over 30 powerful miracles, such as feeding the 5,000 and walking on water

- Be guided by the Holy Spirit, and strengthen your spiritual connection through prayer

- Meet over 60 story-driven characters, including the disciples of Christ. Reenact key moments such as the Last Supper

content_descriptors.notes: It contains scenes from the life of Jesus, including his imprisonment and crucifixion.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7500 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-12100 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1660 SUPER
  • DirectX: Version 12

short_description: Walk in the footsteps of Jesus in this immersive first-person retelling of His life — from birth to resurrection. Perform powerful miracles, meet biblical figures, and explore the Holy Land from Jerusalem to the Galilee. Become the Messiah in I Am Jesus Christ.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
